correctness.rationale: Every admissible indexed length-n weight-three cyclic word has exactly 3 marked representations (i,a,b,c) with gaps >=h and a+b+c=n. There are Q=C(n-3h+2,2) ordered gap triples and checksum 3i+2a+b mod n. If 3 is invertible mod n, each residue receives Q/3 words. If 3|n, eliminating the 3 initial positions reduces buckets to compositions satisfying 2u+v=s mod 3; both nontrivial cubic Fourier transforms equal 1/(1-z^3), giving (Q+2)/3 for s=0 mod3 and (Q-1)/3 otherwise. Independent unordered-position enumeration verified all buckets for 222 parameter pairs through n=40 and h>=2; endpoint n=3h included. This finite check is not the proof.
